noStreams: No active streams. Start publishing to a room to configure this app on it.
smallScreenHint: Tip: zones and lines are best drawn on a larger screen.

hint.zones: Click on the video to add polygon points; drag a point to move it.
hint.lines: Drag on the video to draw the counting line; grab an endpoint to adjust. Add POIs to only count crossings inside a region.
hint.roi: Draw one or more POIs — clicks add polygon points; drag a point to move it. A face is tagged by the POI it falls in.

noPois: No POIs — the whole frame is used.
noShapes: None yet — add one to start.

demography.title: Region & engine
demography.roiHint: Optional — draw one or more POIs to restrict + tag reads by region (whole frame when none).
